title: I Wish You Love, after Michael Bublé

details.title: I Wish You Love
details.lead: Michael Bublé's sung line, played straight on the trumpet, in A♭ so it sits where the trumpet sings: written G4 to G5. Two flourishes only: a quick turn into the bridge's long note, and a last turn home after the final note.
facts: Charles Trenet (Que reste-t-il de nos amours, 1942); English words by Albert Beach
Michael Bublé's singing, read from his voice and straightened
A♭ concert, B♭ for the trumpet
Pickup, A, A, bridge, A, coda
